$comment: Wave V6 of docs/COMPONENT-VARIANTS-PLAN.md. material: the React pack's Material variant, drawn by real MUI components (@mui/material, MIT core only, never MUI X Pro or Premium) with the pack component's own props, themed from the bank tokens by MaterialTheme (react/src/Material.tsx). Each entry is the catalogue component id, the React export that draws it and the MUI parts under it; another wave's React material variant points here, while JET, Angular and React Native draw their Material look themselves (V1 to V5). Gallery: react/gallery ?variant=material&only=<id>. showcase: the components ported from Vengeance UI (MIT) into all four packs.

button.notes: callToAction and solid contained, outlined, borderless as text, danger contained in the error colour

showcase.notice: Copyright (c) 2025-2026 Ashutoshx7; the full MIT notice is at the top of each derived file

share-sheet.changes: On the pack's Sheet; bank channels (copy, email, messages, device share) in place of social apps; no QR (needs an encoder)

glass-dock.changes: One gliding label kept; GSAP MorphSVG icon morphs left out (a paid plugin)

aurora-hero.changes: Bands from the bank tokens; the flutes are a CSS layer, not the SVG displacement filter

reveal-loader.changes: CSS animations and the pack's stagger steps in place of GSAP; covers the content until loading is false

border-beam.changes: A conic light masked to the border in place of offset-path; laps 2 to 20 s

masked-avatars.changes: Initials when there is no photo; the rest counted past max
